_comment: Batch 013 -- the dressing the other three themes place.
The sconce is shot WITH its flame in place and again without, because
the two are separate nodes in the engine and the bracket has to read
as a bracket when the fire is not drawn.
The root is shot as three stacked sections, which is how the engine
will use it: its length is randomised and the mesh tiles at 1.0 m.

shots.name: G_theme_dressing_family
shots.caption: SCONCE + FLAME / TRANSIT SIGN / ROOT FALL / COLUMN STUMP
shots.note: GOTHIC, NEON, TEMPLE - EVERY ONE PLACED BY _THEME_PROPS TODAY

shots.name: G_sconce_pair
shots.caption: BRACKET ALONE, THEN LIT - TWO NODES, NOT ONE
shots.note: IT MUST READ AS A BRACKET WHEN THE FIRE IS NOT DRAWN

shots.name: G_root_stack
shots.caption: THREE SECTIONS STACKED - THE LENGTH IS THE ENGINE'S
shots.note: 1.0 M SECTIONS WITH FLAT ENDS BEAT ONE STRETCHED ROOT

shots.name: G_transit_sign
shots.caption: TRANSIT SIGN - A HOUSING. THE MESSAGE IS THE ENGINE'S
shots.note: SIX LINES ON A LABEL3D. A BAKED ONE WOULD REPEAT IN EVERY ZONE

shots.name: G_column_stump
shots.caption: COLUMN STUMP - BROKEN IN THE TOP 0.4 M, PLAIN BELOW
shots.note: SO AN INSTANCE THE ENGINE SCALES STILL HAS A BROKEN TOP
